entries.rationale: Tailwind 3 build dependency. Vulnerable braces execution observed only during trusted production compilation using repository-controlled content globs. No execution in backend, worker, Nginx runtime or inspected browser artifact. Production users cannot control the patterns supplied to braces. Reviewed 2026-10-11: successor recovery captures and hydrates exact Stage-A prerequisite files and verifies the state backup's semantic identity before storage or restoration. Frontend source, dependency locks, and runtime packaging did not change.
